design.description: A calm, confident adult man in his thirties speaking natural North American English. A relaxed, lower-mid voice with an even, unhurried pace, like an experienced software developer walking a colleague through a product he knows well. Cool and understated, friendly but never salesy, clear articulation, no announcer energy and no drama.
design.passage: Would you hand me the yellow measuring cup before the soup boils over? The quick thinker judged each chance, then sighed with real pleasure.
